body:
§46.5 (landed) promises the MCP-staged sever completes on the admin page's container-drop
confirm. It cannot: planDrop (src/server/admin.ts ~715-753) reaches gw.connectionInboxes only,
and a channel pool lives in gw.channelPools — so loam_federate_drop hands an operator a
confirmAt link to a page whose drop button always refuses 409. Measured during T203's build
(2026-08-21); the refusal is honest ("Nothing was forgotten") but the promised flow is broken
end to end, and no rail covered the gap between the two shipped features.

Build: teach planDrop/postDropConfirm the channel-pool case — resolve the pool through
gw.channelPools (falling back to the byte-verified handle discipline dropChannelImpl already
uses), render the two-sided preview (what goes, what remains — the §46.3 drop semantics), and
complete the sever exactly as `loam federate drop` does: purge proven at the bytes, channel
record negated, replay refreshed.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The confirmAt link from loam_federate_drop leads to a confirm page that renders the
    channel's two-sided preview and health line. Verify: extend the flow in a NEW test file
    test/server/admin-channel-drop.test.ts with the session fixture (admin-channel-health.test.ts is frozen; federate-mcp.test.ts is not, but a new file keeps
    the seam clean).
(b) Confirming completes the sever: pool purged at the bytes AND a bystander channel's pool
    and lens survive (two-sided). Verify: same file.
(c) The refusal for a container that is neither inbox nor channel pool is unchanged. Verify:
    same file.

Merge tier: MYK'S MERGE — this widens what the admin page can purge (a channel pool it could
never purge before). One line for the PR: the admin confirm can now complete the sever §46.5
already promised, purging exactly the pool `loam federate drop` already purges.
title: The staged sever dead-ends — POST /admin/drop cannot complete a channel-pool drop
